stock.description: MIE Holdings Corporation, along with its group entities, is primarily involved in the exploration, development, extraction, and distribution of crude oil and related petroleum products, largely operating under production sharing agreements. The company maintains interests in two active oil production contracts situated in Northeast China. Furthermore, it holds participatory stakes in a single exploration contract and six production contracts within Kazakhstan. Established in 2001, MIE Holdings is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
